comingSoon.title: The club shop is coming soon
comingSoon.text: Club gear for players, families and fans. Check back for our first pre-order window.

offline.label: Pay at pickup
offline.instructions: Payment details will be confirmed by the club before launch. Please contact the club with any questions.

options.label: Illustrative pickup — no orders accepted
options.details: Proof of concept only. No pickup is scheduled.

notifications.confirmationNote: Thank you for supporting the club.

policies.returns: Contact the club about fit or product issues before pickup. Final exchange policy will be confirmed before launch.
policies.sizeGuideGeneral: Check garment measurements before ordering. Contact the club if you need help choosing a size.
policies.preorderExplainer: We collect orders during a pre-order window, then place one production order. Pickup details follow when the gear is ready.
